activity.notes: William Barak (Beruk) succeeded Simon Wonga as Ngurungaeta, the recognised Wurundjeri leader, in 1874 and remained a leading authority and spokesperson until his death on 15 August 1903. ATLAS uses the specific Wurundjeri political community rather than the broader Kulin cultural alliance supplied by the game-style source label.

sources.title: Ancestors & Past — Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Cultural Heritage Aboriginal Corporation
sources.citation_text: The Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Cultural Heritage Aboriginal Corporation states that Barak succeeded Simon Wonga as Ngurungaeta of the Wurundjeri people in 1874 and records his death on 15 August 1903.
